query: INSERT INTO tabac_molecule_links (tabacId, moleculeId, concentration, notes, createdAt) SELECT t.id, m.id, 'Élevée', 'Terpène majeur du Perique fermenté', NOW() FROM tabacs t, molecules m WHERE t.name LIKE '%Perique%' AND (m.name LIKE '%linalool%' OR m.name LIKE '%geraniol%' OR m.name LIKE '%caryophyllene%') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE notes = VALUES(notes);
